assets.subject: Muted dark brick-red cardboard shotgun-shell box with kraft-brown inside flap, no printing. Three fat SHORT CYLINDRICAL red polymer SHOTGUN SHELLS with wide gold-brass rimmed bases and FLAT CRIMPED CLOSED mouths. Every shell distinctly cylindrical with flat ends, NO protruding copper bullet, NO pointed projectile or rifle casing. One shell flat crimp end visible, two side-on to show red plastic hull and thick brass head. Shells broad enough to be unmistakable at48px.
